text: The group algebra $k[G]$ decomposes as a product $B_1 \times B_2 \times \cdots \times B_r$ of indecomposable two-sided ideals called ___.
explanation: The indecomposable two-sided ideal summands of $k[G]$ are its blocks, each carrying an associated defect group that controls its representation theory. They are not the simple modules or the projective indecomposables (which live INSIDE a block) but the ring-level direct factors themselves.
